title: Cosmic Coyote Shaman
description: A surreal night scene features a large, gnarled olive-green coyote with purple patterned ears, glowing yellow eyes, and a long pink tongue dripping orange liquid. The coyote emerges from a metal pot containing cabbages, grapes, and succulents. Below it a demonic cat-like face with flower eyes appears next to a blue hand holding a sign reading 'CHICKEN SHIT'. A full moon with a white wolf silhouette and a glowing blue smiley face float in the dark, cloudy sky.
prompt: A surreal dark night scene with a large twisted olive-green coyote spirit emerging from a metal pot filled with cabbages, red grapes and succulents. The coyote has glowing yellow eyes, purple patterned ears, and a long dripping pink tongue. A demonic black cat face with large flower eyes sits below it. A blue hand holds a dripping sign that says CHICKEN SHIT. Full moon with wolf silhouette in a cloudy sky, glowing blue smiley face, floating orbs, dark branches, weird mystical atmosphere.
